## Distribution Example

```r
library(diffuR)
X <- swiss_roll(2000, noise = 0.1)
fit <- train_diffusion_dist(X, epochs = 10, T = 500, batch_size = 512)

samp <- sample_ddpm(fit, n = 2000, steps = 500)
p <- plot_2d_samples(real = X, fake = `colnames<-`(samp, colnames(X)))
print(p)
```

## Image Example (MNIST)

```r
dl <- mnist_train_dataloader(batch_size = 128)
fit_img <- train_diffusion_image(dl, epochs = 1, T = 500)

imgs <- sample_ddpm(fit_img, n = 16, steps = 500, shape_img = c(28,28))
op <- par(mfrow=c(4,4), mar=c(0,0,0,0)); for(i in 1:16) image(imgs[i,,], col=gray.colors(256), axes=FALSE); par(op)
```
